HIBP Check

Only the first 5 hex chars of the SHA-1 leave this browser.

API

This server re-implements the official Pwned Passwords range API: GET /range/:anonk returns every SHA-1 password sharing that 5-hex prefix, one SUFFIX:COUNT per line. 404 = prefix not found. 

GET /range/:anonk
